item.title: KEXP Cast 0.5.6
item.description: • Outage notice:** when KEXP’s servers stop answering (or your Mac is offline), a notice under the tabs says so, instead of the feed and archive just sitting empty. The app keeps trying, and once KEXP is back the feed and archive reload by themselves.

item.title: KEXP Cast 0.5.5
item.description: • Finer volume control:** click the speaker icons at either end of the volume slider to turn it down or up a little (5% per click). Works for this Mac and for speakers.

item.title: KEXP Cast 0.5.4
item.description: • The menu bar equalizer is calmer: quiet passages now look quiet instead of turning back up to full height after a few seconds, and only real peaks reach the top.

item.title: KEXP Cast 0.5.3
item.description: • On the Radio tab, the colour from the album art now runs all the way up behind the header and tab bar again.

item.title: KEXP Cast 0.5.2
item.description: • Calmer tab bar:** the tab icons now stay in place. Picking a tab fades its name in where the icon was, instead of sliding everything over.

item.title: KEXP Cast 0.5.1
item.description:
• New tab bar:** Settings moved out of the header and into the tabs. The selected tab shows its name; the others are icons only.
  • The Feed tab is now called Radio.

item.title: KEXP Cast 0.5.0
item.description:
• New layout:** the tabs now sit at the top, just under the controls. The player lives on the Feed tab, and Archive, Starred, Downloads and Settings each get the whole window.
  • The Saved tab is now called Downloads.

item.title: KEXP Cast 0.4.4
item.description:
• Fix:** listening through several archive shows in a row could leave the timeline stuck once you reached a show that was still on air when you started (it kept showing the earlier show). The app now re-checks the schedule and moves on correctly.
  • Fix:** the Archive tab’s list for today now updates by itself, so shows that finish airing while the app is open appear without reopening the tab.
  • Right-click the menu bar icon** (or Control-click) for Play/Pause, Open in Window, Check for Updates, and Quit.

item.title: KEXP Cast 0.4.3
item.description: • Easier-to-see volume control:** a white knob, KEXP-yellow fill and brighter speaker icons, so it stands out over bright album art.

item.title: KEXP Cast 0.4.2
item.description:
• A little breathing room at the top of the feed, so the newest song doesn’t touch the tab bar (it scrolls away as you scroll).
  • “Check for updates” now sees a new version the moment it’s published, instead of up to 5 minutes later.

item.title: KEXP Cast 0.4.1
item.description:
• Menu bar:** the icon is now KEXP’s four-bar logo mark all the time. When music plays, those same bars start moving with it, and settle back into the logo when you stop.
  • Speaker button:** now just the speaker icon and arrow; room names are in the menu (hover the button to see where it’s playing).

item.title: KEXP Cast 0.4.0
item.description:
• Sonos:** KEXP Cast now plays on Sonos speakers as well as MusicCast. Pick a room (or several, to play them in sync) from the speaker menu — live or any archive show. Stereo pairs and subs show up as one room, Sonos volume works from the app, and the menu bar bars stay in time with the speaker.
  • The speaker menu lists Sonos and MusicCast rooms separately. Rooms only sync within one brand, so picking the other kind switches over.

item.title: KEXP Cast 0.3.0
item.description:
• New player layout:** volume, speaker picker, settings and pop-out now sit in the header. The current show (with Go live / From the top) is above the song, the song sits in its own card, and the playback controls are centred.
  • DJ notes moved to the feed:** click the quote button on any song to read its note. The player no longer grows and shrinks with long notes.
  • The feed starts right under the tabs, and Settings opens from the gear.

item.title: KEXP Cast 0.2.2
item.description:
• Fix:** the update banner’s buttons (Download, Restart to update, ✕) didn’t respond to clicks — the album-art backdrop below was catching them.
  • “Check for updates” now always says what happened. If you’re on 0.2.0 or 0.2.1: this update downloads by itself within a day and installs when you quit KEXP Cast.

item.title: KEXP Cast 0.2.1
item.description:
• Fix:** with the player popped out into its own window, clicking the menu bar icon showed the small “popped out” card floating inside a large empty window. The menu now fits the card (and goes back to full size when you pop back in).
  • First update delivered through the new automatic updater.

item.title: KEXP Cast 0.2.0
item.description:
• New name:** KEXP Bar is now KEXP Cast. Your settings, stars and speakers carry over.
  • Automatic updates:** new versions download in the background. A banner at the top of the app says when one is ready; click “Restart to update” or just let it install the next time the app quits. Settings has “Check for updates” and an option to be asked before downloading.
  • Menu bar:** the KEXP wordmark when idle; while playing, the four logo bars move with the music (timed to what your speakers are actually playing).
  • Pop-out window:** open the player in its own window from the top-right button; close it or press the pop-in button to put it back in the menu bar.
  • Speakers:** archive shows stream reliably to MusicCast (a minute buffered on the Mac, reconnects without repeating), clean handovers every 3 hours, and both speakers are found right after launch.
  • New app icon from KEXP’s logo; roomier day picker in the Archive.
